name: Nakamura Shiori
source:
Daughter of Aiko Katsuragi. Eldest daughter.
A female teacher who teaches English at the Rinin Academy.
A married woman. She has just married Tomonobu Nakamura, a physical education teacher at her workplace.
She is the most popular among the female teachers because of her innocent demeanor but glamorous body, which is inherited from her mother, and her mild and gentle personality. Many male faculty members and students lament her marriage. She lives with her husband in an apartment for newlyweds a few minutes away from Katsuragi Clinic.
She has known Suzuko Yamazaki for a long time and they are close as senior and junior. She is a good friend of Suzuko Yamazaki, who appears to be cold at first glance to her.

[Translated from the official site of the game, [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080701055257/http://lilith-soft.com/anime/product04.html]archived[/url]]
